title: Harajuku landing
prompt: One continuous six-second cinematic shot of Iron Man Mark III descending into an iconic three-point landing in Harajuku, Tokyo at night, then settling into stillness. Keep the same core action as the reviewed landing pass, but place him on a wet urban street with distinctive Harajuku energy: modern storefront glow, layered Japanese street signage, crosswalk markings, reflected neon color in puddles, and dense city atmosphere kept slightly soft behind the subject so the armor remains dominant and readable. Begin just before impact with restrained downward velocity, then land cleanly: one fist to the ground, one knee bent, opposite arm swept back, a controlled burst of mist, street spray, and light debris pushed outward. After impact, hold for a brief heroic settle with subtle head and shoulder stabilization and fading boot/palm exhaust. Preserve exact Mark III armor construction and panel relationships above all else: red and gold metallic armor, closed gold faceplate, narrow illuminated eye slits, circular chest reactor, accurate helmet proportions, chest geometry, shoulders, gauntlets, thighs, shins, and boots. Emission only from boot soles and palm centers during descent/impact; chest reactor and eyes stay at normal steady brightness. Armor surfaces remain non-emissive metal with realistic reflections from Tokyo signage. No suit transformation, no extra glowing seams, no invented armor details, no cuts, no text or logos in the image, no camera shake, no scorched damage.
